## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL: internal rotation, Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector leadership with Financials, Materials and Industrials showing strength while Technology and Consumer Discretionary lag; Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5). Major divergence across large-cap techs (multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches) supports a neutral stance pending confirmation.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Materials lead: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.34% | 1M: +28.16%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +43.79%). Communication/Media strength from META in RECOVERY (1W: +5.51% | 1M: -2.91%). Financials showing follow-through: V ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.02% | 1M: +4.92%), CME ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +8.07%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Discretionary lagging: NKE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -10.36%), TJX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.31% | 1M: -14.64%). Utilities lagging (sector 1W: -1.47% | 1M: -4.21%) with no clear SP100 leaders in the provided set. Energy showing weakness/rotation: XOM in CORRECTION (1W: -3.99% | 1M: +4.03%), CVX in CORRECTION (1W: -2.70% | 1M: +7.66%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.34% | 1M: +28.16%), DE RECOVERY (1W: +9.28% | 1M: -0.83%), EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +23.96%), META RECOVERY (1W: +5.51% | 1M: -2.91%), CME ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +8.07%). Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical and financial names prominent.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: DOW in CORRECTION (1W: -4.47% | 1M: +5.13%), BA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.55% | 1M: -4.27%), INTU in CORRECTION (1W: -4.58% | 1M: +10.51%), INTC in CORRECTION (1W: -4.91% | 1M: +2.25%), TJX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.31% | 1M: -14.64%). Weakness concentrated in selective Tech and Consumer Discretionary names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: FCX (1W: +14.34% | 1M: +28.16%), DE (1W: +9.28% | 1M: -0.83%), EL (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +23.96%), META (1W: +5.51% | 1M: -2.91%), V (1W: +5.02% | 1M: +4.92%). Note major divergence among mega-caps (NVDA, GOOGL, AMZN show 1W vs 1M mismatches) — tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed-to-cautious: sector 1W: -0.41% | 1M: +8.11% with internal rotation across large caps. MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +26.43%) contrasts with AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -7.75%) and NVDA in CORRECTION (1W: -3.63% | 1M: +6.42%). Sector showing divergence—monitor for leadership consolidation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive and relatively broad: Financials 1W: +0.71% | 1M: +1.30% with Visa ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.02% | 1M: +4.92%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.31% | 1M: +6.35%), and CME ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +8.07%). Breadth within Financials is supporting the market’s neutral tilt toward cyclicals/value.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mixed headline-driven action: JNJ in CORRECTION (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +1.73%) despite very bullish FDA news, while LLY is BELOW TREND (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -2.42%) even with bullish headlines — signaling sentiment/price divergence. Monitor high-news names for follow-through or distribution.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclical/value exposure within a neutral posture: emphasize select Financials (V, MA, CME) and Materials (FCX, NEM) while reducing exposure to names showing short-term exhaustion in Tech and Discretionary. Style: Value/Cyclical favored, but major tech divergences warrant selective positioning and monitoring.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.34% | 1M: +28.16%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +43.79%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +26.43%). BEARISH: WMT BELOW TREND (1W: -8.50% | 1M: -7.52%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -2.42%), BA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.55% | 1M: -4.27%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +5.75%) and Financials (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +1.30%) on strong individual leaders and breadth. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -2.18%) and Utilities (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -4.21%) where weakness is concentrated.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA in CORRECTION (1W: -3.63% | 1M: +6.42%) — watch recovery above recent swing highs for resumed momentum. AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -7.75%) — support tests would signal stabilization. MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +26.43%) — hold through-breakout level for continued leadership; WMT BELOW TREND (1W: -8.50% | 1M: -7.52%) — breakdown below prior lows increases downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JNJ (+85): JNJ in CORRECTION (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +1.73%) after big FDA win — sentiment confirmed at news-release but price shows short-term pullback. NVDA (+65): NVDA in CORRECTION (1W: -3.63% | 1M: +6.42%) — earnings/AI headlines bullish but 1W weakness signals distribution to monitor. LLY (+80): LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -2.42%) — bullish Alzheimer headline vs falling price is a divergence; watch for follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTU (-50): INTU in CORRECTION (1W: -4.58% | 1M: +10.51%) — downgrade aligns with 1W weakness, confirming near-term risk. UNH (-40): UNH in RECOVERY (1W: +3.19% | 1M: -6.48%) — Tepper selling headlines are bearish while price shows short-term bounce; divergence to monitor. AMAT (-50): AMAT not in detailed key list here but negative headlines on China exposure warrant watching related equipment names for downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
NEUTRAL, style: Value/Cyclical favored. FCX ABOVE TREND, MSFT ABOVE TREND and V ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among large-cap Tech (NVDA, GOOGL, AMZN) and several healthcare/news-driven mismatches (JNJ, LLY) — monitor for confirmation before enlarging risk.
